picture_book.instructional_kernel: Ninereeds begins a bounded instructional greeting and identity-verification chain with Taro. The chain's persistent goal is to establish and verify Ninereeds's stable identity across the later interlocutor transition. Pages 01-04 establish the greeting and identity exchange with Taro; page 04 affirmatively confirms Ninereeds but has no meeting-close form, so the identity-verification chain remains open. At page 05 the visible scene changes to a full Ninereeds-Emma pair, and Emma advances the same unresolved goal by rejecting Taro as Ninereeds's identity, requesting self-identification, and offering an Emma-or-Ninereeds discrimination. The ordered two-person scenes carry one persistent identity event across the transition. Page 08 is the sole resolution: Emma says 'Nice to meet you.' and Ninereeds says 'Nice to meet you, too.'. The bounded identity-verification chain stops with Ninereeds and Emma as the visible pair.
